correctness.rationale: Pure two-term Schmidt amplitudes under a product single-mode parity-definite Kraus branch give p_j cos²φ=cos²θ |a_0b_0|² and p_j sin²φ=sin²θ |a_1b_1|². Summing successful branches and using terminal completeness bounds total P by the minimum of two ratios. The diagonal concentration filter diag(t,1), t=tanθ/tanφ, and dilution filter diag(1,t), t=tanφ/tanθ, attain the ratios. Their one-mode diagonal form is a scalar multiple of exp(k n), a fermionic Gaussian filter, and the rank-one diagonal complement is a Fock-state Gaussian projection. Odd-odd parity products can be composed with local particle-hole flips under the explicitly declared generalized Gaussian convention.
